entities.name: Final Hours
entities.description: The apocalyptic event in Naktamun that unfolded in four hours after the Second Sun aligned.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker who deceived Amonkhet's people and gods and defeats the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city on Amonkhet where the Final Hours take place.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The desert world ruined by the Final Hours.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A team of planeswalkers who fight on Amonkhet and are defeated by Bolas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose mind Bolas shatters.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who fights mummies and relies on the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who finds Amonkhet's cycle of life poisoned by Bolas.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker nearly killed by Bolas.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who stands at Oketra's side and is driven away by Bolas.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A winged demon, sworn enemy of Liliana, struck down by the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: The god of strength, killed by the Scorpion God.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god who falls in her final battle with the Scorpion God.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: A god who falls during the Hour of Promise.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god who protects mortals and vows to safeguard the spirit of Amonkhet.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: A god who exploits Hazoret's compassion and is slain by Bolas.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: One of three gods of destruction emerging from the Gate, with the head and tail of a scorpion.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A fighter who leaps to defend Naktamun.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A fighter reunited with Samut.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Embalmed lazotep-plated undead warriors, the worthy dead remade into soldiers.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact Liliana draws on whose power proves no match for Bolas.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: The protective barrier that kept the desert's horrors at bay.

events.summary: In 4560 AR the Second Sun aligns between the horns of the God-Pharaoh's throne and the Gate to the Afterlife opens, unleashing the end of the world for Amonkhet.
events.quote: Instead of welcoming the God-Pharaoh 's return, this event unleashed the end of the world for Amonkhet .

events.summary: Bolas's deception is revealed as three gods of destruction shatter the Hekma and slay most of the other gods while mummies and Eternals attack.
events.quote: Three unknown gods of destruction emerged, shattered the Hekma , and slew most of the other gods.

events.summary: The gate reveals the Crypt of the Eternals filled with preserved dead instead of paradise.
events.quote: the people found only rows of silent tombs, and the Throne of the God-Pharaoh still sat vacant.

events.summary: The Gatewatch strike down the demon Razaketh, sparing Liliana from using the Chain Veil.
events.quote: the planeswalkers struck the demon down swiftly, sparing Liliana from resorting to the hated power of the Chain Veil .

events.summary: The Scorpion God emerges from a sarcophagus and kills Rhonas with its tail.
events.quote: Yet the Scorpion God's tail struck with lethal force, and Rhonas fell in agony

events.summary: Samut leaps to fight back against the monstrous invaders.
events.quote: Samut leapt to fight back, determined to protect Naktamun from betrayal and ruin.

events.summary: A locust-headed god devours the Hekma's protective magic, letting sands and mummies pour into Naktamun, and the God-Pharaoh appears and mocks the people.
events.quote: These locusts devoured the protective magic of the Hekma , tearing down the barrier that kept the desert’s horrors at bay.

events.summary: Oketra dies facing the Scorpion God as Gideon witnesses; Kefnet falls too.
events.quote: When Oketra and Kefnet fell, the two surviving gods turned on each other

events.summary: Bontu exploits Hazoret's compassion and drags her before the God-Pharaoh.
events.quote: Bontu, however, exploited Hazoret's compassion, striking when she was most vulnerable.

events.summary: Bolas slays Bontu and Hazoret breaks free with her faithful.
The scarab-headed god leads Bolas's Eternals out of the necropolis.
events.quote: These were Bolas 's Eternals : the worthy dead of Naktamun, remade into flawless soldiers

events.summary: Samut and Djeru reunite and rally surviving initiates against the Scorpion God and the Eternals.
events.quote: Rallying as many surviving initiates as they could, they fought back against the Scorpion God and the Eternal horde.

events.summary: The living bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk; Hazoret vows to stand by the mortals.
events.quote: the living managed to bring down the Scorpion God by driving it onto an obelisk

events.summary: Bolas shatters Jace's mind and Jace vanishes into the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Jace could not resist — and Bolas shattered his mind like glass.

events.summary: Bolas shows Liliana the Chain Veil is no match, shows Nissa that the cycle of life is poisoned, and crushes Chandra in his claws.
events.quote: where he snuffed out her fire and crushed her nearly lifeless in his claws.

events.summary: Bolas drives a claw through Gideon's defenses until his invulnerability falters and Gideon flees, leaving Bolas triumphant.
events.quote: Bolas drove a claw through Gideon’s defenses until his invulnerability faltered, forcing him to flee as well.

Samut and Djeru were finally reunited.
